Metadata.title: PSG Zurich
Metadata.description: Official Paris Saint-Germain supporters club in Zurich.

ComingSoon.title: Coming soon
ComingSoon.body: The website of the official Paris Saint-Germain supporters club in Zurich is on its way. In the meantime, get in touch:

Login.title: Sign in
Login.error: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
Login.notVerified: Please confirm your email address first: we just sent you a new link.
Login.linkInvalid: This confirmation link is no longer valid. Sign in to get a new one.

ForgotPassword.title: Forgot password
ForgotPassword.body: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
ForgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, you will receive a link to choose a new password. It is valid for one hour.

ResetPassword.title: New password
ResetPassword.body: Choose a password of at least 8 characters.
ResetPassword.invalidLink: This link is no longer valid. Please request a new one.
ResetPassword.done: Password saved. You can now sign in.
ResetPassword.error: The password could not be saved. Please try again later.

Membership.title: Join
Membership.body: Become a member of the official PSG supporters club in Zurich.
Membership.terms: I accept the club's <statutes>statutes</statutes> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
Membership.emailTaken: An account already exists for this email. Please sign in.
Membership.error: Sign-up failed. Please try again later.
Membership.sentBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to activate your account: it is valid for 24 hours.
Membership.sentHint: Nothing received? Check your spam folder, or sign in to get a new link.

news.title: News
news.description: The latest news from the club.

events.title: Events
events.description: Watch parties, away trips and members' get-togethers.

membership.title: Membership
membership.description: Join the official PSG supporters club in Zurich.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: A question? Write to us at contact@psg-zurich.ch.

AdminBanner.title: Announcement banner
AdminBanner.description: Message shown at the top of every page. Only one announcement is live at a time; publishing an active one replaces the previous.
AdminBanner.messagePlaceholder: One short sentence, on one line.
AdminBanner.error: The announcement could not be saved.
AdminBanner.invalid: Check the fields: French title and message are required, link must be valid.

Footer.tagline: Official supporters club, certified by Paris Saint-Germain.

resetPassword.subject: Choose your password — PSG Zurich
resetPassword.preview: Your link to choose a new password
resetPassword.heading: New password
resetPassword.body: Click the button below to choose your password. This link is valid for one hour.
resetPassword.ignore: If you did not request this, simply ignore this email: your current password stays unchanged.

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email — PSG Zurich
verifyEmail.preview: One last step to activate your account
verifyEmail.heading: Welcome to PSG Zurich
verifyEmail.body: Click the button below to confirm your email address and activate your account. This link is valid for 24 hours.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you did not create an account, simply ignore this email.

membershipRequest.subject: New membership request: {name}
membershipRequest.heading: New membership request
membershipRequest.body: {name} ({email}, {city}) has just confirmed their address and wants to join the club. Accept or refuse the request from the administration.
membershipRequest.footer: You receive this email as a PSG Zurich administrator.

membershipApproved.subject: Welcome to PSG Zurich!
membershipApproved.heading: Welcome, {firstName}!
membershipApproved.body: The committee has accepted your membership request. Your member number is {number}. Find your details and the next steps in your member area.
membershipApproved.footer: A question? Write to us at {email}.

membershipRejected.subject: Your membership request — PSG Zurich
membershipRejected.heading: Hello {firstName},
membershipRejected.body: After review, the committee was unable to accept your membership request. In accordance with the statutes, you may appeal to the next general assembly.
membershipRejected.footer: For any question or to appeal, write to us at {email}.

AdminMembers.title: Membership requests
AdminMembers.description: Accept or refuse new sign-ups. The member is notified by email.
AdminMembers.unverifiedHint: The applicant must confirm their email address first.
AdminMembers.confirmReject: Refuse this membership request? The person will be notified by email.
AdminMembers.error: Action failed. Reload the page and try again.

AdminRoles.title: Administrators
AdminRoles.description: Administrators approve memberships and manage content. Only a superadmin can name or remove them.

errors.self: You cannot change your own role.
errors.superadmin: Superadmins are managed in the database.
errors.error: Action failed. Please try again later.
